summary: Use changes between visible planes as the main visual rhythm, not merely as an accidental low-resolution result.
objective: Facet boundaries reinforce the intended form instead of producing arbitrary patchwork, and the object remains readable in shadow.
intent_signals: Reveal angular form through light and shadow
example_prompts: Create a faceted mountain island whose broad planes lead the eye toward a summit.

principles: Use changes between visible planes as the main visual rhythm, not merely as an accidental low-resolution result.
implementation: Arrange plane sizes to emphasize the major form; reserve small facets for a focal ridge or transition.
Use a directional key and restrained fill so adjacent planes remain distinct without making half the subject unreadable.
Use a slow inspection orbit or deliberate turning beat that reveals successive planes; keep the background quieter than the surface.
Grade facet sizes across roughly 3:1 - large planes on the primary mass, small facets only along one focal ridge - and bevel every silhouette edge by 1-2 mm so each border catches a highlight line.
Place the key at 28 degrees elevation so adjacent planes land at least 12% luminance apart; verify in a grayscale screenshot that no two touching facets share a value.
observable_checks: Facet boundaries reinforce the intended form instead of producing arbitrary patchwork, and the object remains readable in shadow.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 0.95; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Pair with monochrome study or surreal proportions; choose actual planar geometry when the edge silhouette must carry the effect.

defaults.rationale: The whole look is the value difference between neighbouring planes, so the ratio is pushed to 8:1 and the key kept low at 28 degrees: a high or soft key would land several facets on the same step and collapse the rhythm. Roughness stays low (0.2-0.45) with a light clearcoat on the focal ridge so facet borders read as crystal edges, and exposure is pulled to 0.95 to keep the specular crests from clipping into one white mass.

palette.role: specular crest along the focal ridge

values.value_structure: 45/35/20 dark/mid/light; adjacent facets differ by >= 12% luminance
values.saturation_rule: body facets <= 35% saturation; the one warm accent facet up to 65%

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 8:1 - the wide ratio is what separates neighbouring planes

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: flat shading with clearcoat 0.3 on the focal ridge only; 1-2 mm bevel on every silhouette edge so borders read as a bright line

values.signature_technique: a grazing 28 degree key swept across the facet field so every plane lands on a different step of one value ramp
never: smooth normals over the facet field
more than one accent facet colour
randomly sized facets with no size grading
a frontal key that flattens the planes
